items.title: Apple AirPods 5 bring open-ear ANC, Siri AI and Live Translation at $129
items.summary: Apple launched the AirPods 5 on September 18, its most affordable open-ear model to add Active Noise Cancellation, removing up to 50 percent more ambient noise than the AirPods 4 with ANC. The buds integrate hands-free Siri AI and on-device Live Translation, with the $149 wireless-charging variant adding stem volume swipe and up to 22 hours of total battery life.

items.title: Omdia: TWS shipments slip 0.7% in Q2 2026 as open-ear audio jumps 12%
items.summary: Omdia's Q2 2026 data shows global true wireless stereo shipments fell 0.7 percent year over year to 82.1 million units, the first annual decline since Q2 2023, while open wireless stereo grew 12 percent to 11.1 million units and lifted its share to 13.5 percent. Apple held the top spot with 20.5 percent share on 1.2 percent growth, and only Apple and OPPO among the top five posted gains; Omdia forecasts OWS to nearly double to 90.5 million units by 2030.

items.title: Oppo Enco X4 go global with AI translation, Dynaudio tuning and 400% faster lossless
items.summary: Oppo launched the Enco X4 true wireless earbuds globally on September 22, featuring a coaxial dual-driver system co-developed with Dynaudio, a 6nm chip with AI noise cancellation and lossless transmission claimed up to 400 percent faster than the previous generation. Each 5.6g earbud adds AI-powered real-time translation, IP55 protection and a design aimed at all-day comfortable wear.

items.title: Bose expands open-ear lineup with Sport Open Earbuds and Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen
items.summary: Bose unveiled the Sport Open Earbuds at $199 and the Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen at $299 on September 17, both built on Bose OpenAudio technology with SpeechClarity AI voice isolation. The flagship Ultra Open adds deeper bass, Cinema Mode with TrueSpatial and up to 9 hours of playback, with pre-orders opening September 19 ahead of an October 1 launch.

items.title: Vivo Buds Clip launch with 42-hour battery life and real-time translation
items.summary: Vivo launched its first open-ear clip-on earbuds, the Buds Clip, in China on September 21 with up to 42 hours of combined battery life, spatial audio, AI call filtering and simultaneous connections to three devices. Each 5.2g earbud uses a flexible memory-titanium bridge and supports LDAC and Hi-Res Audio Wireless, positioning it as a rival to the Huawei FreeClip 2.

items.title: boAt Airdopes Prime 800D bring Google Gemini Crest AI to budget earbuds
items.summary: boAt launched the Airdopes Prime 800D in India on September 21 at Rs. 1,999, the first earbuds to feature its Crest AI platform built with Google Gemini. The TWS earbuds add Dolby Audio, 11mm drivers, Bluetooth 6.1 and up to 45 hours of playback, while Crest AI enables voice questions, Gmail or Calendar assistance and real-time translation across more than 25 languages.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 named best overall wireless earbuds of 2026
items.summary: Stuff's September roundup names the Sony WF-1000XM6 the best overall wireless earbuds of 2026, praising refined noise cancellation from eight microphones and a new QN3e processor, balanced punchy sound from an 8.4mm driver and a more comfortable, narrower shell. Battery holds at 8 hours with ANC on and 24 hours with the case, with a 10-band EQ in the app.

items.title: Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition pairs LHDC 5.0 and 50dB ANC with Hogwarts design
items.summary: Realme launched the Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition in India on September 21 at Rs. 6,999, a themed reskin of the standard T500 Pro with a Hogwarts-crest case and Magic Brown finish. Underneath the design it keeps 12.4mm drivers, LHDC 5.0 hi-res audio, up to 50dB hybrid ANC, six-microphone calls and 56 hours of total battery life, with sales starting September 22.

items.title: Huawei FreeBuds 7 debut with 2.3x ANC, 4.6Mbps lossless and AI translation
items.summary: Huawei unveiled the FreeBuds 7 on September 7 with a 4.3g semi-in-ear design and an upgraded AI perception noise-cancellation algorithm that delivers 2.3 times deeper average cancellation than the previous generation. The buds add a custom 10.8mm driver, up to 4.6Mbps lossless transmission, 100dB two-way silent calls and AI translation, with 42 hours of total battery life.

items.title: Noise Master Buds Open bring Sound by Bose tuning to open-ear earbuds
items.summary: Noise unveiled the Master Buds Open at IFA Berlin 2026, its first open-ear earbuds built on Sound by Bose technology, with a clip-on C-shaped design, 10.8mm drivers, spatial audio, four-microphone calls and dual pairing. Priced between 99 and 199 euro, the buds target commuters and runners and went on sale in late September across retail and e-commerce channels.
